h.en: 4.1.1 Plastic families, properties and resin identification
h.gu: 4.1.1 Plastic Families, Properties અને Resin Codes

body.en:
Thermoplastics soften/melt on heating and can often be remelt-processed within degradation limits. Thermosets cure into crosslinked structures and do not simply remelt. Elastomers have rubber-like response;thermoplastic elastomers combine particular features. Fillers,reinforcement,additives and grade alter properties.

SPI resin identification codes1–7 identify resin families,not a guarantee of local recyclability,food-contact approval,microwave safety or universal reuse. Look for the marked grade/product guidance;the symbol alone is not a material test.
body.gu:
Thermoplastics heatથી soften/melt અને limits હેઠળ reprocess. Thermosets crosslink cure પછી simply remelt નહિ. Elastomers rubber-like;TPE particular combined features. Additives/fillers/grade properties બદલે.

SPI/resin codes1–7 resin ઓળખ છે,local recycling,food,microwave,reuse guarantee નહિ. Product/grade guidance જુઓ;symbol material test નથી.

body.en:
1 PET/PETE:good clarity,stiffness and useful gas barrier in suitable grades;beverage bottles and fibre/packaging. Bottle production commonly combines injection-made preforms with stretch blow moulding.

2 HDPE:good toughness,chemical resistance and low moisture uptake;blow-moulded containers,extruded pipes and injection parts.3 PVC:rigid or plasticised flexible grades;chemical resistance and electrical applications include pipes,cable insulation and profiles. PVC formulation and overheating/decomposition hazards demand compatible equipment/ventilation.
body.gu:
1 PET/PETE clarity,stiffness,gas barrier;beverage bottles/fibre/packaging. Bottles commonly injection preform+stretch blow.

2 HDPE toughness,chemical resistance,low moisture uptake;containers,pipes,parts.3 PVC rigid/plasticised flexible;pipe,cable,profiles. Formulation અને overheating/decomposition hazards માટે compatible equipment/ventilation.

body.en:
4 LDPE:flexible,tough,good moisture resistance;films,bags,squeeze bottles and cable coverings.5 PP:low density,chemical resistance and useful fatigue performance in properly designed living hinges;containers,caps,household/automotive parts.

6 PS:rigid clear general-purpose grades are relatively brittle;impact-modified grades differ,and foam grades serve insulation/protective packaging. Heat/solvent resistance is grade-limited. Do not infer that every item of one resin family has identical strength or service temperature.
body.gu:
4 LDPE flexible/tough/moisture resistant;films,bags,squeeze bottles,cables.5 PP low density,chemical resistance,suitable living-hinge fatigue;containers,caps,parts.

6 PS clear rigid grades relatively brittle;impact grades અલગ;foam insulation/packaging. Heat/solvent resistance grade-limited. Same family એટલે identical strength/service temp નહિ.

body.en:
ABS:impact toughness,dimensional utility and mouldability;housings,appliances and automotive trim. PC:high impact resistance,clarity and useful heat resistance in suitable grades;guards,lenses and electrical housings. Nylon/polyamide:wear resistance,strength and useful sliding behaviour;gears,bushes and engineering components.

These commonly fall under7 OTHER rather than dedicated unique SPI numbers. Nylon absorbs moisture,affecting dimensions/properties;many engineering resins require controlled drying before processing. PC/ABS blends and reinforced grades differ from unmodified resins. Grade approval—not resin name alone—determines food/safety suitability.
body.gu:
ABS impact toughness/mouldability;housings/appliances/trim. PC impact/clarity/grade મુજબ heat resistance;guards,lenses,housings. Nylon wear/strength/sliding;gears,bushes,engineering parts.

સામાન્ય રીતે7 OTHER;unique dedicated SPI number નહિ. Nylon moisture absorbથી dimensions/properties બદલાય;ઘણી resins controlled drying માંગે. Blends/reinforcement અલગ. Food/safety માટે grade approval જરૂરી.

title.en: 4.2 Moulding processes: detailed construction and working

body.en:
A screw plasticises resin,then an axial shot fills a clamped mould;cooling solidifies a thermoplastic part before ejection.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A hopper supplies identified,prepared resin to the feed throat.
  2. A heated barrel supports the screw and controlled melt path.
  3. A reciprocating screw rotates to plasticise/meter and translates to inject.
  4. A nozzle connects the injection unit to the mould feed.
  5. A clamping unit holds fixed/moving mould halves against shot pressure.
  6. Thermal controls and mould cooling manage melt and solidification.
  7. Ejection,guards,interlocks and controls coordinate safe part removal.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Identify grade,conditioning/drying needs and approved setup.
  2. Feed prepared resin;rotating screw conveys,heats and meters a shot.
  3. Close/clamp the mould with protective systems active.
  4. Axial screw motion injects melt through nozzle/runner/gate.
  5. Apply specified packing/hold while cooling and gate freezing occur.
  6. Cool sufficiently;plasticise the next shot as the cycle allows.
  7. Open/eject by the designed sequence and inspect before the next cycle.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Complex repeat parts,caps,housings and engineering products. High productivity/detail but costly moulds,clamp force,shrinkage/warpage and material conditioning are limits. No universal temperature or pressure setting is implied.
body.gu:
Screw resin plasticise કરે,પછી axial shot clamped mould ભરે;cooling પછી ejection.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Hopper identified/prepared resin આપે.
  2. Heated barrel screw/melt path support.
  3. Screw rotateથી plasticise/meter,translateથી inject.
  4. Nozzle mould feed જોડે.
  5. Clamp fixed/moving halves pressure સામે રાખે.
  6. Thermal/cooling melt/solidification manage.
  7. Ejection/guards/interlocks safe removal coordinate.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Grade,conditioning/drying,setup verify.
  2. Resin feed;rotating screw convey/heat/meter.
  3. Protective systems સાથે mould clamp.
  4. Axial screw nozzle/runner/gateથી inject.
  5. Specified pack/hold,cool,gate freezing.
  6. Sufficient cooling;cycle મુજબ next shot.
  7. Designed open/eject/inspect,next cycle.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Complex repeat parts/caps/housings. Productivity/detail લાભ;cost,mould/clamp,shrinkage/warpage,conditioning limits. Universal settings નથી.

h.en: 4.2.2 Injection mould: components and their functions

body.en:
The mould defines the part,feeds melt,removes heat and releases the product. Its components are not interchangeable with the machine barrel.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Fixed and moving plates support cavity/core inserts and the parting interface.
  2. Core and cavity surfaces define internal/external product geometry.
  3. Sprue bush,runner and gate guide melt and influence filling/packing.
  4. Guide pillars,bushes and locating features align halves repeatedly.
  5. Cooling passages remove heat without leaking into the cavity.
  6. Ejector pins/plate and return system release the part from the intended side.
  7. Vents,slides/lifters where needed and support plates manage gas,undercuts and load.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Guide features align the halves as the mould closes.
  2. Clamp/support holds the parting interface under filling load.
  3. Melt passes through the sprue/runner/gate into cavity and around the core.
  4. Vents discharge displaced gas while designed geometry limits flash.
  5. Cooling/packing develop the solid part and dimensional condition.
  6. After opening/undercut release,the ejector system advances safely.
  7. Ejectors return and the mould is checked/ready for closure.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Correct gates,cooling,venting and ejection prevent many short shots,burns,sink/warpage and damage. Part defects require process/tool/material diagnosis,not simply more pressure.
body.gu:
Mould part define,feed,cool અને release કરે;machine barrelથી અલગ.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Fixed/moving plates cavity/core/parting support.
  2. Core/cavity inside/outside geometry આપે.
  3. Sprue/runner/gate fill/pack control.
  4. Guide pillars/bushes halves align.
  5. Cooling passages heat દૂર કરે,leak નહિ.
  6. Ejector pins/plate/return intended release.
  7. Vents/slides/lifters/support gas,undercut,load manage.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Close વખતે guides align કરે.
  2. Clamp/support parting hold કરે.
  3. Melt feedથી cavity/core આસપાસ.
  4. Vents gas છોડે;geometry flash limit.
  5. Cooling/packing solid dimensions આપે.
  6. Open/undercut release પછી ejector advance.
  7. Ejectors return,mould ready/check.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Correct gates/cooling/vent/ejection short-shot,burn,sink/warpage/damage ઘટાડે. દરેક defect માટે “more pressure” solution નહિ.

body.en:
Air inflates a hot hollow parison against a split-mould cavity to form a hollow container.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. An extruder/head produces the hot tubular parison.
  2. A split mould defines the outside product shape.
  3. Clamping/pinch-off features close and seal required parison ends.
  4. A blow pin/air route supplies controlled inflation air.
  5. Parison control/handling manages placement and wall distribution.
  6. Mould cooling removes heat from the inflated wall.
  7. Guards,ejection and trimming provisions support safe bottle removal.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Select suitable resin/conditioning and the approved bottle programme.
  2. Extrude the controlled hot parison in the mould region.
  3. Close/pinch the mould to capture and seal the required length.
  4. Introduce air through the blow arrangement to expand the tube.
  5. Hold/cool until the wall retains the moulded shape.
  6. Release air safely,open and remove the container.
  7. Trim flash and inspect leakage,wall distribution and dimensions.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Bottles,tanks and hollow packaging;low mass/hollow shape are merits. Wall variation,flash and neck limits matter. Injection-blow uses a preformed injection blank;stretch-blow stretches a conditioned preform,often PET,then inflates it.
body.gu:
Air hot hollow parisonને split cavity સામે inflate કરી hollow container બનાવે.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Extruder/head tubular parison આપે.
  2. Split mould outside shape આપે.
  3. Clamp/pinch features ends seal કરે.
  4. Blow pin/air route controlled inflation આપે.
  5. Parison control placement/wall distribution.
  6. Cooling wall heat દૂર કરે.
  7. Guards/ejection/trimming safe removal આપે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Suitable resin/conditioning/programme પસંદ કરો.
  2. Controlled hot parison extrude.
  3. Mould close/pinchથી length capture/seal.
  4. Blow airથી tube expand.
  5. Shape retain થાય ત્યાં સુધી hold/cool.
  6. Safe air release,open,remove.
  7. Trim;leak,wall,dimensions inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Bottles/tanks/hollow packs;light hollow shape લાભ. Wall variation,flash,neck limits. Injection-blow preform;stretch-blow conditioned preform stretch+inflate,commonly PET.

body.en:
A rotating screw continuously plasticises and forces polymer through a shaped die;downstream sizing/cooling fixes the continuous profile.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A hopper/feed throat supplies prepared resin.
  2. A heated barrel contains the rotating screw.
  3. Screw sections convey,compress and meter melt.
  4. Breaker/screen equipment where specified supports flow/filtering with controlled pressure drop.
  5. A shaped die defines film,pipe,rod or profile geometry.
  6. Sizing,cooling and haul-off control dimensions and speed.
  7. Cutting/winding,guards and pressure/temperature controls finish the line.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Confirm resin,conditioning and approved line setup.
  2. Feed resin into the screw with guarded controls.
  3. Screw motion and heat plasticise/meter the polymer.
  4. Pressurised melt flows through the die continuously.
  5. Size/cool the section while controlled haul-off draws it away.
  6. Cut or wind after the required cooling/conditioning stage.
  7. Inspect section,wall and surface;isolate before die/screen service.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Pipes,films,sheets,cable coatings and profiles. Continuous output is economical;constant-section limitation,die swell,cooling distortion and pressure hazards require control. Die shape alone does not guarantee final dimensions.
body.gu:
Screw continuously plasticise/dieથી flow;downstream sizing/cooling profile fix કરે.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Hopper/feed prepared resin આપે.
  2. Heated barrel rotating screw રાખે.
  3. Screw convey/compress/meter કરે.
  4. Specified screen/breaker filtering/flow support.
  5. Die film/pipe/rod/profile geometry આપે.
  6. Sizing/cool/haul-off dimensions/speed control.
  7. Cut/wind/guards/controls line પૂર્ણ કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Resin/conditioning/line setup verify.
  2. Guarded controls હેઠળ feed.
  3. Screw/heat plasticise/meter કરે.
  4. Pressurised melt continuous dieથી જાય.
  5. Size/cool સાથે haul-off.
  6. Required cooling પછી cut/wind.
  7. Section/wall/surface inspect;service પહેલાં isolate.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Pipes/films/sheets/cables/profiles. Continuous economical;constant section,die swell,cooling,pressure limits. Die shape એકલું final dimensions guarantee નહિ.

body.en:
A measured resin charge melts/coats the inside of a heated mould rotating about two axes;cooling preserves a hollow wall.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A separable hollow mould defines the outside shape.
  2. A measured powder/liquid resin charge matches the specified system.
  3. A biaxial support/drive rotates the mould through controlled motion.
  4. An oven/heating station heats the mould and resin.
  5. A designed vent accommodates pressure/gas exchange without resin escape.
  6. A cooling station removes heat while rotation continues as specified.
  7. Handling,guards and temperature/cycle controls protect hot moving equipment.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Prepare the clean mould and approved measured resin charge.
  2. Load and close the mould with its designed vent arrangement.
  3. Rotate about the specified axes through the heating stage.
  4. Resin softens/melts and progressively coats the interior surface.
  5. Continue controlled rotation/cooling to retain the wall distribution.
  6. Open only at the required safe release condition and demould.
  7. Inspect wall,voids,warpage and trim/finish as specified.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Large tanks,bins and hollow products,often polyethylene. Low pressure and large seamless shapes are merits;long cycles,wall control,material range and thermal history limit use. It is not high-speed centrifugal metal casting.
body.gu:
Measured resin heated two-axis rotating mould અંદર coat કરે;cooling hollow wall રાખે.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Separable hollow mould outside shape આપે.
  2. Measured resin charge system મુજબ.
  3. Biaxial support/drive controlled rotation આપે.
  4. Oven mould/resin heat કરે.
  5. Designed vent gas/pressure manage કરે.
  6. Cooling station specified rotation સાથે cool.
  7. Handling/guards/cycle controls hot moving hazard માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Clean mould/approved charge prepare.
  2. Load/close અને designed vent.
  3. Heating દરમિયાન specified two-axis rotate.
  4. Resin melt/soften થઈ inner surface coat.
  5. Wall distribution માટે controlled rotate/cool.
  6. Safe release condition પછી open/demould.
  7. Wall/void/warpage inspect,trim/finish.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Large tanks/bins,hollow products,often PE. Low pressure/large seamless લાભ;long cycle,wall,material/thermal limits. આ centrifugal metal casting નથી.

body.en:
A measured charge is compressed in a heated matched mould;thermosets flow and cure under controlled conditions.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A rated press/frame supplies controlled closing force.
  2. Matched mould halves define the component.
  3. Heaters/temperature controls condition the tooling.
  4. A measured charge or preform suits resin volume and flow.
  5. Vents/flash lands manage gas and excess resin.
  6. Ejector/handling provisions release the cured part.
  7. Guards,interlocks and extraction control press and resin hazards.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Identify compound and approved cure/handling requirements.
  2. Prepare mould and place measured charge safely.
  3. Close with controlled force so the charge spreads into the cavity.
  4. Maintain specified heat/pressure while gas escapes by design.
  5. Allow the required cure;thermoset crosslinking is not just cooling.
  6. Open/eject at the specified safe release stage.
  7. Trim flash and inspect cure,fill,dimensions and damage.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Electrical components,thermoset handles and reinforced parts such as suitable SMC/BMC products. Simple feed and large parts are merits;cycle time,flash,charge placement and cure control are limits. Thermoplastic compression routes differ in solidification.
body.gu:
Measured charge heated matched mouldમાં compress;thermosets flow/cure થાય.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Rated press/frame closing force આપે.
  2. Matched halves component define કરે.
  3. Heaters/controls tooling condition કરે.
  4. Measured charge/preform volume/flow મુજબ.
  5. Vents/flash lands gas/excess manage.
  6. Ejector/handling cured part છોડે.
  7. Guards/interlocks/extraction press/resin hazards માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Compound/cure/handling verify.
  2. Mould/charge safe prepare/place.
  3. Controlled closeથી cavity spread.
  4. Designed gas escape સાથે heat/pressure.
  5. Required cure;crosslink coolingથી અલગ.
  6. Specified safe stage પર open/eject.
  7. Trim/cure/fill/dimensions/damage inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Electrical/thermoset handles/reinforced SMC/BMC parts. Simple feed/large parts લાભ;cycle,flash,charge,cure limits. Thermoplastic route solidification અલગ.

title.en: 4.3 Selection, safety and observed practical work

h.en: 4.3.1 Select the process from the product—not the resin code alone

body.en:
Bottle:blow moulding,often PET preform/stretch-blow or HDPE extrusion-blow. Continuous pipe/profile:extrusion. Complex solid housing/cap:injection. Large hollow water tank:rotational moulding in a suitable resin. Thermoset electrical handle/cover:compression with a compatible compound.

Check quantity,wall distribution,tolerances,undercuts,resin rheology,cure/thermal behaviour,tooling cost and service need. One product can have multiple feasible routes. SPI code alone cannot select the machine or certify recycled feed purity.
body.gu:
Bottle blow,commonly PET preform/stretch અથવા HDPE extrusion-blow. Continuous pipe/profile extrusion;complex housing/cap injection;large hollow tank rotational;suitable thermoset handle/cover compression.

Quantity,wall,tolerance,undercuts,rheology,cure/thermal,tooling/service check. એક product માટે multiple routes possible. SPI code machine selection/recycled purity certificate નથી.

body.en:
Control hot barrels/melt,press clamping points,stored hydraulic/pneumatic pressure,unexpected motion,purging fumes and pellet slips. Use rated guards/interlocks,isolate before tooling maintenance and follow resin-specific drying/purge/changeover instructions. Never burn unknown plastic to identify it. PVC and other resins can release hazardous decomposition fumes on overheating.

Short shots,flash,sink,warpage,voids,burn marks and weld lines require diagnosis of resin,tool,venting,thermal and flow conditions. Regrind is permitted only within the material/product specification. A cooling-water leak into hot process areas needs the site emergency procedure,not an improvised adjustment.
body.gu:
Hot melt/barrel,clamp,stored pressure,unexpected motion,purge fumes,pellet slip hazards. Guards/interlocks,isolation,resin-specific dry/purge/changeover. Unknown plastic burn કરીને identify નહિ. Overheatથી hazardous fumes.

Short shot,flash,sink,warpage,void,burn,weld lines માટે resin/tool/vent/temp/flow diagnosis. Regrind specification મુજબ જ. Cooling leak માટે site emergency procedure.

body.en:
For3–5 household items,record the actual mark,likely resin,product function and a justified process choice;mark uncertain/unmarked items as uncertain. Do not declare food safety or recyclability from a guess.

During an authorised visit,identify hopper/barrel/mould/clamp/guard locations without crossing barriers. Record only observed stages and approved explanations. A report can compare construction,working and selection across the five processes. These notes do not claim an industrial visit or a fabricated machine trial.
body.gu:
3–5 household items માટે actual mark,likely resin,function,justified process લખો;uncertain/unmarkedને uncertain જ. Guessથી food/recycling safety નહિ.

Authorised visitમાં barriers પાર કર્યા વગર hopper/barrel/mould/clamp/guards ઓળખો. Actual observed/approved explanation જ report. આ notes visit/trial claim નથી.

items.f: 1 PET/PETE;2 HDPE;3 PVC;4 LDPE;5 PP;6 PS;7 OTHER

terms.en: ABS,PC,Nylon often OTHER;code is not food/recycling certification.
terms.gu: ABS,PC,Nylon commonly OTHER;code safety certificate નહિ.

Injection=complex repeat parts
Blow=hollow containers
Extrusion=continuous section
Rotational=large hollow shapes
Compression=matched-tool charge,frequently thermosets
